defaultPrompt: Interview me to clarify my requirements.
Critically review your previous answer and correct errors.
Juniorize your previous answer for a junior employee.
Prepare a handoff from this conversation.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial, skills-only toolkit with four workflows adapted from selected Matt Pocock skills, a conversation-context filter, an original critical-review skill, and Juniorize for reducing the complexity of answers and documents while preserving accuracy and applying the conversation-context filter for self-contained results. Instructions are in English; responses follow your language. No runtime scripts required.

name: clarity-toolkit
description: Interview requirements, prepare questionnaires, explain confusing messages, hand off context, filter conversation traces, critically revise answers, and simplify complex content into clear, self-contained text.
